title: App preview
generating: The coding agent is building the project in a sandbox container…
empty: Confirm the UI baseline, then click "Generate project" — a coding agent builds a complete multi-file React app in a sandbox, then you can open it in your browser from here.
needConfirmHint: UI baseline not confirmed yet; you can still generate, but confirming first is recommended.
readyHint: It's deployed to this session's preview URL — open it in a new tab to run it with a native, full-page browser experience.

public.onHint: Public: anyone with the link can open this preview (no login). Click to make it private.
public.offHint: Private: only you can see it. Click to expose it on the public internet and get a shareable link.

toast.madePublic: Preview is now public — anyone with the link can open it
